scope: Distinct review of screenshot fixture harness, coordinate protocol, manual bridge and timeout corrections; excludes separately authored vision editor and future Modal runtime composition.
conclusion: No additional concrete defect found in the reviewed trusted-adapter source scope after the stated corrections. This is not a model result, full runtime admission or a physical process/cancellation bound.
resolved_findings: Fresh original case remaining time is checked before creating a policy task; an expired window starts no policy call.
Actual installed Playwright TimeoutError is separately caught and permanently latches the session; next-case construction is refused.
Context close and video.path share one original finalization deadline; failed/unknown finalization remains fatal rather than allowing a fresh10s window.

Follow-up known-late acceptance check: actual policy text/token counts returned after the original case deadline remain recorded with pending false and no action; an actual late native UI receipt stays recorded while success remains false. Both latch the session.
verified_boundaries: Only screenshot, human goal, viewport, action budget/sequence and prior issued-action feedback reach the injected policy. Source, DOM records, target coordinates and Python expected state are excluded. The trusted callback still has normal Python privileges, so this is an interface boundary rather than an adversarial sandbox.

Eight development and eight verification scenarios have fixed distinct seeds, opposite layout per family and disjoint word vocabulary; complete manifest includes goal/oracle/viewport/fixture identity. Generic HTML may be shared. Verification has not received a model evaluation through this harness.

Click/type/key/scroll/done batches are validated atomically; CSS pixel coordinates match device_scale_factor1 viewport screenshots. Type/select-all require current editable focus without selecting targets or exposing the focus query to the model. Coordinate bounds do not prove target semantics.
Fixture JavaScript records ordinary UI actions; Python checks final receipt against withheld expected state. A model done claim cannot grant success.

Manual bridge binds session/case/sequence/screenshot and observation hashes. Complete command bytes are atomically published once using an exclusive pending file and hardlink; collision cleanup preserves another writer. Unknown actor tokens/cost remain unknown.

Cases record actual PNG/WebM artifacts and timing separately. Video path/size/hash return is not a decode check or frame-exact action alignment. Actual videos still need decode/visual QA before publication.

Manual actor labels are caller declarations and require actual external provenance. Human/tool coordination elapsed time is not API inference latency. Tiny browser fixtures and qualitative demonstrations cannot establish Astra superiority or native desktop/mobile performance.

validation.historical_local_browser_evidence: Initial-source author record172b99b9 preserves11tests including eight development reference UI flows, eight verification render-only checks and done-only actual WebM/manual bridge. These are test doubles, not model results; I did not rerun them or retroactively claim they cover corrected branches.

remaining_integration_requirements: A future model runtime must bind this exact source, actual checkpoint/recipe/provenance, idle edits and cache reset, source-bound resource reservation, complete paired metrics and independent process disposition.

Timeout/cancellation does not stop a background model thread/service; an independent owner is required for unknown native/model disposition. Disk/native encoder allocation and synchronous I/O are not physically bounded by post-return checks.
Keep new verification outside development selection and freeze one candidate first. No checkpoint export, provider deployment, public publication or model promotion is performed by this review.
